<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    o=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='O']
    g=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N']
    y=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y']
    def bb(n):
        ps=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in ps),min(p[1] for p in ps),max(p[0] for p in ps),max(p[1] for p in ps))
    return ("O",bb(o[0]) if o else None),("N",[(bb(x),x['pixels']) for x in g]),("Y",len(y))
print("BEFORE:",snap(current_frame))

print("click green peg:",res.get('board_changed'),res.get('gameplay_changed'),res.get('no_impact'),res.get('level_completed'))
print("AFTER click:",snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>

def snap(f):
    o=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='O']
    g=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N']
    y=[n for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y']
    def bb(n):
        ps=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in ps),min(p[1] for p in ps),max(p[0] for p in ps),max(p[1] for p in ps))
    return ("O",bb(o[0]) if o else None),("N",[(bb(x),x['pixels']) for x in g]),("Y",len(y))
